consent.title: Can we use analytics cookies?
consent.text: We'd like to use Google Analytics to see which pages visitors find useful. It sets cookies and sends details of your visit to Google, so it stays off unless you agree. You can change your mind at any time from “Cookie settings” at the bottom of every page.
events.empty: Nothing is listed right now. Know about something happening in Dhaka? Suggest it and an editor will add it.
